name: PrintableTools Lab Organic Push Kit Mirror
purpose: GitHub Pages discovery mirror for low-risk organic distribution tasks that send real visitors to free no-signup tools before display ads.

tasks.title: Helpful reply for PDF under 1MB questions
tasks.trigger: Use only when someone asks how to make a PDF smaller for a job, school, email, or form upload.
tasks.copy: If the portal says your PDF must be under 1MB, this free browser tool can try compressing scans or image-heavy PDFs locally: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/compress-pdf-to-1mb/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=upload_error_cheatsheet&utm_content=community-pdf-1mb. Check the result before submitting, because very small targets can reduce quality.
tasks.successSignal: One real visitor lands from community UTM and downloads a PDF after the reply.
tasks.riskRule: Do not post in unrelated threads, do not claim guaranteed compression, and do not use private documents as examples.

tasks.title: Helpful reply for 100KB photo upload questions
tasks.trigger: Use when a job, exam, school, or profile form rejects an image because it is over 100KB.
tasks.copy: For a 100KB image limit, this free no-signup browser tool can compress an image locally: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/compress-image-to-100kb/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=upload_error_cheatsheet&utm_content=community-image-100kb. Review the preview before uploading it anywhere, especially for ID-style photos.
tasks.successSignal: One image-tool visitor arrives from community UTM and triggers a download.
tasks.riskRule: Do not ask users to share IDs, faces, payment documents, or private files publicly.

tasks.title: Directory listing for free no-signup file tools
tasks.trigger: Use on directories that accept free productivity, PDF, image, QR, or no-signup tools.
tasks.copy: PrintableTools Lab is a free no-signup browser utility site for common PDF, image, QR, and paperwork tasks: compression targets, PDF-to-JPG, image-to-PDF, QR codes, invoices, receipts, labels, flyers, resumes, and more. Listing URL: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/submit-directory/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=free_tool_depth&utm_content=directory-free-file-tools
tasks.successSignal: Directory referral appears in live metrics or directory monitor moves from pending to listed.
tasks.riskRule: Use truthful free-tool claims only; do not resubmit duplicates or imply official endorsement.

tasks.title: Support thread resource for exact upload errors
tasks.trigger: Use where support communities allow a resource link for file-size, file-type, or image-dimension rejection messages.
tasks.copy: I keep a free upload-error cheatsheet for common messages like PDF under 1MB, image under 500KB, JPG under 200KB, PNG screenshot too large, invalid JPG/PNG type, and resume PDF too large: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/upload-error-cheatsheet/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=upload_error_cheatsheet&utm_content=support-upload-errors
tasks.successSignal: Upload-error-cheatsheet UTM visits increase and at least one visitor clicks into a fixer page.
tasks.riskRule: Only share as a relevant resource; do not mass-post or ask for ad clicks.

tasks.title: Short demo for strict 500KB PDF forms
tasks.trigger: Use for a 15-30 second silent demo on Shorts, TikTok, Bilibili, Douyin, or Reels.
tasks.copy: Hook: Form says PDF must be under 500KB? Show a generic PDF, choose the 500KB target, download the result, and remind viewers to check readability. Link: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/compress-pdf-to-500kb/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=zero_cost_push&utm_content=short-video-pdf-500kb
tasks.successSignal: Short-video UTM produces at least one PDF download or returning page view.
tasks.riskRule: Use generic sample files only and avoid guaranteed approval language.

tasks.title: Short demo for PDF not accepted, JPG required
tasks.trigger: Use when the content angle is forms that accept images but reject PDFs.
tasks.copy: Hook: Website rejects PDF but asks for JPG? Show PDF pages converted to images locally in the browser, then download the image files. Link: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/pdf-not-accepted-jpg-required/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=zero_cost_push&utm_content=short-video-pdf-to-jpg
tasks.successSignal: Short-video UTM produces a visit to the PDF-to-image workflow.
tasks.riskRule: Do not use real private forms, IDs, medical, legal, or payment documents in the demo.

tasks.title: GitHub Pages mirror for accepted IndexNow discovery
tasks.trigger: Use in resource lists that prefer GitHub Pages mirrors or crawlable static pages.
tasks.copy: Static mirror for common upload errors and direct free fixes: https://yanqr213.github.io/printable-tools-lab/upload-error-cheatsheet/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=upload_error_cheatsheet&utm_content=github-pages-cheatsheet. The live tools remain on PrintableTools Lab and downloads stay free.
tasks.successSignal: GitHub Pages sitemap and IndexNow accepted URL count remain above 151 and referral visits appear.
tasks.riskRule: Mirror is for discovery only; send users to the live free tools for actual file work.

tasks.title: Upload-limit fixer for file-size questions
tasks.trigger: Use only where someone asks how to make a PDF, JPG, PNG, resume, or passport photo fit a named upload limit.
tasks.copy: If the site gives a file-size or format error, this free upload-limit fixer maps the message to the right no-signup PDF or image tool: https://printable-tools-lab.pages.dev/upload-limit-fixer/?utm_source=github-pages&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=free_tool_depth&utm_content=free-tool-depth-upload-limit
tasks.successSignal: free_tool_depth visits increase and at least one visitor opens a fixer tool or downloads a processed file.
tasks.riskRule: Answer the specific upload problem only; do not ask for ad clicks, payments, or private files.

safeUseRules: Share only where the linked tool directly solves the topic.
Do not ask for ad clicks, ad views, artificial engagement, upvotes, or fake traffic.
Use generic sample files only; never post private IDs, payment documents, or user files.
Revenue is still unproven until ad payout, platform payout, or another payment provider shows settled money.
successGate: A task is working only when live metrics show real visits, tool-depth clicks, downloads, search exposure, or accepted external listing evidence.
